newsitem.title: USA: United Auto Group in $50 mln credit pact.
newsitem.headline: United Auto Group in $50 mln credit pact.

text.p: United Auto Group Inc said Monday it had secured a $50 million revolving credit agreement from Bank of Nova Scotia, Morgan Guaranty Trust Co, Chase Manhattan Bank, Credit Lyonnais and Comerica Inc.
It said the funds will be used to acquire automotive dealerships and for working capital.
Marshall Cogan, who was recently named chairman and chief executive officer of United Auto, effective April 17, said the capital commitment enhances the company's ability to acquire auto dealerships.
He said the company recently agreed to buy three new Ford dealerships in the Chattanooga, Tenn., and Atlanta markets.
United Auto operates 41 franchises in Arizona, Arkansas, Connecticut, Georgia, New Jersey, New York, Tennessee and Texas.
